settings.aboutBody: E-Eye is a low-cost screening device that estimates refractive error using eccentric infrared photorefraction. It helps decide who should be referred for a full eye exam.
settings.disclaimerBody: E-Eye is intended strictly for refractive error screening in community settings and does not replace a comprehensive examination by a licensed eye care professional.
